prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium shot. A family seen from behind, their faces never visible, in ankle-length rough undyed wool robes and head-cloths, barefoot, looking up at a rainbow in silence, a small child among them pointing at it. Golden light after rain. Promise. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
